title: How ZIA API changes become live: saving versus activating

prose.text: A ZIA write is not live until it is activated {{saved-not-live}}, and the activation call is separate from the write, although ending a session can activate on its own [[zia.terraform.activation-methods:session-end-autoactivation]]. The Terraform side of this is in [[zia.terraform.activation]], and the product-level lifecycle across ZIA and Cloud and Branch Connector is in [[doc:references/shared/activation.md]].

prose.label: The calls.
prose.text: {{sdk-activation-endpoints}} {{oneapi-sample-activate}} Which path the legacy guide names is in dispute {{divergence:activate-path-differs}}. The Python call names are in [[zia.sdk-python.client-errors-and-accessors:activation-accessor]].

checks.do: Whether the activation status reads PENDING or INPROGRESS after a write, before looking for a platform fault.
Which activate path the client calls: the SDK and the OneAPI sample use POST /status/activate; the legacy PDF names POST /status.

saved-not-live.statement: The vendor's URL Categories API guide says to activate configuration changes after making them, by sending a POST request, so changes made through the API are saved but not live until then.

quotes: After making any configuration changes, ensure that you activate them by sending a POST request to /status.

sdk-activation-endpoints.statement: The Python SDK's activation client reads the activation status with a GET to /status and activates pending changes with a POST to /status/activate.

quotes: Returns the activation status for a configuration change.

oneapi-sample-activate.statement: The OneAPI sample endpoints document POST /zia/api/v1/status/activate as the call that activates saved changes, required after any ZIA configuration change.

quotes: Activates the saved configuration changes. Required after any ZIA configuration change.

status-values.statement: The activation call returns a status of ACTIVE, PENDING or INPROGRESS.

activate-path-differs.summary: The legacy URL Categories guide says to activate by POSTing to /status, while the SDK and the OneAPI sample use POST /status/activate.

positions.says: Activation is a POST request to /status.

quotes: by sending a POST request to /status.

positions.says: Activation is a POST to /status/activate; GET /status only reads the status.
The OneAPI sample activates with POST /zia/api/v1/status/activate.

activate-path-differs.impact: A client that follows the PDF literally and POSTs to /status would not call the endpoint the SDK uses; use the activate path.
